periods.summary: Ein joins Or-Gaule after becoming bored with assassination as paid work and wanting to use lives to bloom beautiful flowers. At Rebellion headquarters she kills seven Apostles by planting magical roses in their bodies, keeping them alive in agony. She later infiltrates the Vermillion palace with Sleep Beauty lilies whose pollen paralyzes everyone except Sirius. She introduces herself as a nameless visitor temporarily called Ein, says she has brought funeral flowers, and explains her uterus-housed seed Device Astaroth. Sirius resists, but she disables him with Thorn Whip and attempts to plant Vampire Queen in his wounds. Yui Tatara, disguised as a maid, blocks the seed and confronts Ein for murdering their family and clients, leading to an assassin duel interrupted by Or-Gaule's announcement.

key_events.summary: Kills seven Rebellion Apostles with blood-fed flowers.
Paralyzes the palace, cripples Sirius, and is confronted by Yui Tatara.
